Primary friction is economics of dedicated commit + token pricing for high QPS personalization.

- "We can justify the value if unit cost gets below $0.0009/token for embeddings-heavy use, otherwise it inflates our CAC." — Head of Product

- OpenAI cited as fallback for fast time-to-market, but long-term cost concerns are higher.

- Produce a reworked unit economics model: show cost at QPS tiers with Optimize recommendations applied (caching, batching, quantization suggestions).
- Engage Solutions Architect + Finance to propose a flexible billing cadence (monthly guaranteed vs true-up) and get legal read on residency clause.
